description.value: At 7th level, every time a summoner casts a summoning spell or uses his summon monster ability, he can choose any one teamwork feat he knows. All creatures summoned by the spell or ability are treated as if they had the chosen feat for all purposes, without needing to meet any prerequisites. At 12th level and again at 17th level, the number of teamwork feats that he can choose increases by 1. He cannot choose the same feat twice. At 20th level, all creatures summoned are treated as if they knew all of the summoner's teamwork feats.
